description: Matanya Horowitz is not above dumpster diving in the name of innovation. His company, AMP Robotics, has developed robots to help waste management facilities better sort through incoming trash and separate recyclables. AMP has tested and refined their technology since launching in 2014, in part with materials that Matanya and his team personally picked from the garbage. Today, their robots can be found in hundreds of facilities worldwide, including some of their own. This week on How I Built This…
classificationReason: Focuses on AMP Robotics’ systems for automated recycling and robotic waste sorting, alongside company building and investment.
qualityReason: The excerpt provides sustained discussion of robotics and recycling economics, including vision systems, robotic picking, vacuum technology, training data, purity targets, commodity pricing, labor costs, deployment, and adoption constraints. The founder offers first-hand technical and operational knowledge, and the interview develops a coherent topic despite some transcript corruption.
